$comment: The pins the leaves carry that no package registry can check: hosted-model retirement dates, service api-versions and npx package pins. Maintained by hand from vendor sources, like data/certifications.json; each entry records where its facts were read.

scripts/check-currency.mjs reads this weekly (`.github/workflows/currency.yml`, read-only): a model retirement inside its warning window fails the run, a passed review_by date fails the run, and a pinned npm or PyPI package whose major version is behind is annotated but does not fail - some pins (mermaid on 11.x) are deliberate holds.

review_by is the editorial deadline to re-read the entry's source: api-versions and tool pins do not retire on a published date, so the deadline is ours. Reviewing means re-reading the source and moving review_by forward (or changing the pin).
